GREENKO INTEGRATED MANAGEMENT SYSTEM

                                                  WORK INSTRUCTION FOR HYDRAULIC HUB FILTER DIRTY

1.     PURPOSE
       This document describes the standard operating procedure for Hydraulic HUB filter dirty.

2.     SCOPE

       This document applies to Gamesa model in G97 & G114.

3.     ERROR CRITERIA
       This alarm is monitored when the filtered oil temperature is above 20ºC and it is
       triggered 2 seconds after the pump is activated and no signal is received from the filter.
4.     RESPONSIBILITY
       Authorised person only

5.     Safety Requirements :
       1.   Basic PPE's - Safety Shoe, Safety Helmet, Hand Gloves, safety harness etc.
       2.   Read turbine safety manual before carry out any work in the turbine
       3.   Always complete safety documentation part - work permit etc.
       4.   Risk assessments and HIRA to be cross checked for the Job activity.
       5.   690 V/ 230 V will be available on control panel. Be careful.

6.     SPARES, CONSUMABLES, TOOLS & TACKLES.

       Tools :       1. Multimeter - 1 No,
                     2. Spanner set - 1 set,
                     3. Screw driver & Voltage tester - 1 No each,
                     4. Craft work box (small) - 1 No.

       Spares & Consumables:
           1.Hub filter
           2.DI module
7.     DOCUMENTS & RECORDS
       Title                                Form No.
       Work permit

       Work at height                       F-CO-EHS-13-08

       Electrical isolation                 F-CO-EHS-13-04

       Check list                           CL- Wind-SG-EM-211

    8.      PROCEDURE
       1.       Check for any dust accumulation and clean the same if dust exists.
       2.       Check the Signal coming from DI Module
       3.       Check the Feedback back signal from the filter switch
       4.       Replace the filter if dirty
